newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on technicals.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer on Thursday after the steady falls for the past three trading days, shrugging off the news Japan rubber stocks at the end of December showed a moderate increase from December 20, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.2 yen per kg firmer. Most-active benchmark June was up 0.5 yen to 145.9 yen.
"The market was lifted mainly by technical-led short-covering and the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar," one trader said. Further gains could be capped by profit-taking, he added.
